entry.name: The repair on a copy of the live store
entry.expected: Follow the 'AC4 steps' in PLAN-2.md Notes. Use sqlite3 .backup to copy the live terminus.db to a scratch dir, copy the waiting decision files beside it, and take the before counts. Then run TERMINUS_DATA_DIR=<copy> terminus ingest from this branch's release build. Afterwards: the three searches that are doubled today return each turn once; terminus status --json sessions equals the discovered files, with each sidecar link counted once, plus the archive-only sessions (176 at the 2026-10-19 measurement); SELECT session_key FROM sessions WHERE session_key LIKE '-code-cadence/388a000f%' returns one row; terminus verify is clean; and no dangling label or decision turn id count is higher than before.
entry.why_human: Out-of-reach resource. This dispatch forbids copying or opening the live store at /data or ~/.local/share, so the verifier could not run it. It needs no judgment: anyone allowed to copy the store can run it as the command sequence above.
